title: Lossless Compression of Proximity Graph Indexes for Efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.37176v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) indexes, such as HNSW, are the backbone of modern vector search. However, their massive memory footprint creates a severe infrastructure bottleneck. While vector quantization is widely adopted to reduce the memory required to store data vectors, the graph's edge structure increasingly dominates total memory usage. Compressing these adjacency lists for online search presents a critical system challenge: because decompression occurs during query processing, i.e., while navigating the graph, memory savings cannot come at the expense of query latency. In this paper, we present a compression technique explicitly tailored for live HNSW routing. By applying offline graph permutations to artificially induce structural locality, we enable the use of SIMD-accelerated integer compressors, such as Stream VByte, for rapid on-the-fly decompression. translated_title: 面向高效近似最近邻搜索的邻近图索引无损压缩
translated_abstract: 基于图的近似最近邻（ANN）索引，如HNSW，是现代向量搜索的基石。然而，其巨大的内存占用造成了严重的基础设施瓶颈。虽然向量量化被广泛采用以减少存储数据向量所需的内存，但图的边结构日益成为总内存使用的主要部分。为在线搜索压缩这些邻接列表带来了一个关键的系统挑战：由于解压缩发生在查询处理过程中，即在图导航期间进行，因此内存节省不能以牺牲查询延迟为代价。本文提出了一种专门为实时HNSW路由定制的压缩技术。通过应用离线图置换来人为地诱导结构局部性，我们使SIMD加速的整数压缩器（如Stream VByte）能够进行快速的即时解压缩。在多样化的真实世界工作负载上的评估表明，我们显著……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种专为HNSW实时路由设计的无损压缩技术，通过离线图置换诱导结构局部性，使SIMD加速的整数压缩器（如Stream VByte）能够在不牺牲查询延迟的前提下快速解压邻接列表，从而大幅降低图索引的内存占用。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a lossless compression technique tailored for live HNSW routing, which applies offline graph permutations to induce structural locality, enabling SIMD-accelerated integer compressors like Stream VByte to decompress adjacency lists on-the-fly without sacrificing query latency, thereby significantly reducing the memory footprint of graph-based ANN indexes.
